compliance.seismic: Designed to meet Telcordia Technologies Zone 4 earthquake requirements (environmental table wording, transcribed)

environmental.storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C in shipping container

physical.weight: 23.6 kg chassis with midplane, fan tray and air filter; 58.1 kg maximum configuration (Table 88)

power.cooling-system-w: 85 W high-capacity (70 W normal); dedicated PSU tap, excluded from the output-power budget per the guide note
power.psu-system-output: AC normal-capacity 2054 W low-line / 1590 W high-line; DC normal-capacity 1600 W (Table 95, SYSTEM output for the required PSU set - no per-module nameplate is published)

thermal.max-thermal-output: AC 7161 BTU/h (2100 W); DC 5074 BTU/h (1488 W) (environmental table; provisioning ceiling)

configs.description: AC-powered chassis - normal-capacity AC supplies (high-line uses PEM0/PEM2; the four-bay low-line form is drawn).
configs.name: ac

configs.description: Chassis only - what you spec before deciding what goes in it. The 4 slot bays are EMPTY; cooling, craft, psus are populated. Enough to power on and reach the box, which is the question most people ask first and the one `default` used to answer with whatever the drawing happened to be populated with.
configs.name: base

configs.description: DC-powered chassis as photographed - four normal-capacity DC PEMs, two SCB-MX with RE-S-1300, DPC 40xGE in slot 2 and DPC-R-4XGE in slot 1.
configs.name: dc

gaps.wanted: orthographic imagery for the current MPC/SCBE2-SCBE3/RE-S-X6 generation - the intake holds their figures and power tables but no straight-on photography, so the EOL FRUs the reference photograph carries are what is modelled. The power tables for the newer FRUs are already transcribed in the guide extraction for when they are built.
faces for the high-capacity AC/DC supplies (figures 15/17 are isometric line art only).
vendor dimensions for the craft panel and cards - no physical dimension for either exists in the intake, so faces are sized to the photographed apertures.
transceiver lists per DPC/MPC (external compatibility tool).

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

a top-level `profile:` naming the device class, so that `specified` has something to judge the attrs against - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml for the classes that exist, which unlocks `specified` and with it the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 11 bays (front 5, rear 6) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.chassis: datasheet-table - guide chassis description and Table 88: 8.71 x 17.45 x 24.5 in (221.2 x 443 x 622 mm) to the chassis rear (703 total with cable management), 23.6 kg bare / 58.1 kg maximum. Ears are NOT MODELLED by project convention
provenance.color: photo - dark charcoal chassis bands, grey craft panel with the light-blue accent strip, silver card faces (the 40xGE DPC is charcoal), bright aluminium rear
provenance.esd-front: guide Figure 1 callout - ESD point at the front top-left; placed at 8.0, 17.0 off the photograph, approximate (the socket is small and dark against the dark band)
provenance.front-rows: photo - top vent band 0-32.8, craft interface 32.8-75.3, card cage 84.6-206.4 as four 30.45 mm slots (top to bottom: DPC2, DPC1, SCB1/DPC0, SCB0 - the craft tabs and left-flange legends number them 2, 1, 1/0, 0), bottom band to 221.2. Card apertures span x 11.5-432.4 between the flanges
provenance.lifecycle: announced - the third-party EOL trackers (IT-Planet, Park Place) list MX240 EOL 2020-06-30 / EOS 2026-06-30 for the older base bundles while later revisions continued shipping; Juniper's per-SKU M/MX milestones page is authoritative and the milestones are per-SKU, searched 2026-08-27
provenance.other-faces: near-blank by evidence - the guide side art (Figure 1) shows the right side's round-hole exhaust field; sides carry an estimated vent-field band (right) and rail band (left), top and bottom rail edges only. Axis conventions per viewer3d.js: LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR, RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT, top/bottom y = 0 at the FRONT
provenance.populated-with: photo - the reference unit carries DPC 40xGE (DPCE-R-40GE- SFP) in slot 2, DPC-R-4XGE in slot 1, and SCB-MX with RE-S-1300 in both SCB slots; those exact FRUs are modelled and seated as the defaults, EOL though they are, because they are what the only orthographic photograph shows. Current-generation cards (MPCs, SCBE2/3, RE-S-X6) are in the intake's figures and power tables but have no orthographic imagery - see gaps
provenance.power: guide power tables - base system 40 W, cooling 70/85 W (normal/high capacity, from a dedicated PSU tap excluded from the output budget), SCB-MX 185 W at 55 C, DPCE-R-40GE-SFP 335 W, DPC-R-4XGE-XFP 310 W (Table 93; ambient unqualified for DPC rows). No chassis-level draw is published - the vendor instructs computing a budget per configuration (Table 94 worked example), so no power-typical/max is carried on the device and the module figures are what sums
provenance.rear: photo - four PEM bays across the top (x 11.0 on a 101.9 mm pitch, rows 8.9-88.6), PEM 0-3 legends on the plate below each bay, the protective-earthing studs at the top right (two, vertically at 426.7, y 22.2/35.4 - pitch read off the photo, approximate), the rear ESD socket at 356.4, 173.6, and the vertical air-filter (left) and fan-tray (right) door strips with their two-line legends on the plate. The large caution-text plate between them is not transcribed
provenance.scale: photo - BOTH DAM photographs pass the orthographic gate (front 0.1%, rear 0.7%) and are cropped exactly to the 443 x 221.2 body, so every position is a direct measurement at 3.386 px/mm. This is the first device in the set whose photos carry geometry on both axes; the guide figures were used for identification and vocabularies only
provenance.sources: MX240 Universal Routing Platform Hardware Guide (163 captioned figures), HPE datasheet a00150825enw, and the Juniper image-library photographs mx240-front-high and mx240-rear-high. No mechanical drawing was available
